name: Gardien
description: Survivant adaptatif se déplaçant librement dans les territoires que les factions refusent d'occuper durablement.

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavily improvised armor assembled from welded scrap metal plates, repurposed mining‑suit components, and duct‑tape reinforcement; cracked welding‑helmet visor with opaque scratched glass; asymmetrical plates and exposed cable harness; utility belt loaded with magnetic clamps, plasma cutters, and scavenged grenades.
loadout.arsenal: Primary: Jury‑rigged plasma harpoon rifle with exposed copper coils, duct‑taped battery pack and built‑in kinetic dart launcher. Secondary: Pneumatic rivet gun re‑painted as a close‑combat bludgeon; auxiliary tools include a handheld plasma cutter and a magnetic grappling hook.

attitude.behavior: Combat stance with weapon raised and ready; body coiled like a spring, eyes locked on the approaching enemy silhouettes through thick smoke; every muscle prepared to explode into action.
attitude.emotion: Intense, adrenaline‑fueled focus; cold determination mixed with feral aggression; a survivor's resolve burning behind the cracked visor.

palette_names.name: Rust Orange
palette_names.role: Accent rust patches and weathered paint

palette_names.name: Grease Black
palette_names.role: Oil stains, deep shadows, and mechanical recesses

palette_names.name: Faded Synthetic Blue
palette_names.role: Worn fabric straps, patches, and decals

palette_names.name: Construction Yellow
palette_names.role: Hazard stripes, warning markings, and tool highlights

palette_names.name: Hot Plasma Blue
palette_names.role: Energy glow from weapon, impacts, and plasma arcs

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic high‑contrast illumination with flickering plasma glow, point‑source sparks, and dynamic rim light; harsh emergency LEDs mixed with ambient industrial haze; multiple light sources from nearby plasma impacts and smoldering debris.
color_and_light.mood: Chaotic, tense, desperate, heroic – a desperate last stand in a war‑torn asteroid waystation.

camera.angle: Low angle with a slight Dutch tilt to emphasize the towering, improvised armor and the looming threat, conveying urgency and instability.

scenography.setting: Active warzone at an asteroid waystation crossroads; corrugated metal walls scarred by plasma burns; makeshift barricades built from cargo containers, broken hull plating, and twisted scaffolding; debris floating in micro‑gravity; allied forces crouched behind cover; enemy silhouettes advancing through thick smoke.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Plasma rounds impacting corrugated walls, sending molten debris and sparks raining down; dense particulate smoke swirling around combatants; occasional blue plasma arcs crackling across the scene; flickering emergency lights and dust motes illuminated by the plasma glow.
